messages:
jia: FYI: tonight 23:00-01:00 UTC change window. Three-way coord: API config flip, router header-split, runtime kernel bump. Need a tight pin + rollback plan.

deploybot: Change window booked 2026-03-23T23:00Z-01:00Z. Requested locks: api, router, runtime. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/change-window

samir: Runtime note: v3.2.1 has quantized kernels and scheduler tweak. Canary plan: 2% for 10m -> 10% for 10m. Abort if p95 +200ms OR error-rate >2.5% OR throughput -10%. Watch GC tail-latency.

alex: Console will delay header UI flip until router+runtime stable for 10m after final stage. If rollback happens, console stays on safe routing.

maria: API will stage api-v2.6.0 but hold route until router pinned. If router not pinned at T0, keep api-v2.5.9. Draft release notes: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-change-draft.md

jia: Plan summary:
1) pre-T0: clear short TTLs, pin candidates
2) T0: pin router & runtime, start canary (2% -> 10%)
3) T+20m: evaluation by @samir
4) T+30m: console flip if green for 10m
5) rollback immediate if criteria met (commands below)

samir: Commands I'll run on thumbs:
```
# pin artifacts
deployctl pin router=router-v2.6.1 runtime=runtime-v3.2.1
# staged canary
deployctl canary --service router --stages "2%:10m,10%:10m" --notify
```

ops-bot: Alerting set: notify = #incidents, #eng-oncall. SLO guards: p95 delta >200ms OR error-rate >2.5% => auto-alert. Rollback target: router-v2.5.9.

maria: Infra reminder: prime caches or enable read-through fallback 30m before T0 to avoid mixed prefixes.

jia: Decision owner at evaluation = @samir. If abort, samir runs rollback and pings ops. Please react :thumbsup: when ready.

(End of thread)
